convention-probe.title: convention-probe
convention-probe.author: gwendall, chipvoice project
convention-probe.purpose: INIT's own calling convention: A, X, Y and PHP-pulled P, stored straight to $D400-$D403 once, read back as a write-stream instead of inferred from the file format document's prose. Its byte-stream comparison against the oracle is expected to stop at the X register (index 1): the format spec never defines X or Y, chipvoice deliberately zeroes them, and libsidplayfp's own reference driver leaves them holding whatever incidental value an unrelated setup branch happened to load - see docs/chips/c64.md.

frame-rate-probe.title: frame-rate-probe
frame-rate-probe.author: gwendall, chipvoice project
frame-rate-probe.purpose: PLAY's own cadence: a start marker in INIT, then one INC $D400 every call, for many frames - whether PLAY is called once a frame, at the tune's declared speed, and how closely its cycle lands against a real per-line VIC-II's own raster IRQ.
